notes: Cited pnpm advisories that cannot be fixed yet. make security-scan-ui runs pnpm audit --json, then scripts/pnpm_audit_allowlist.py: an unlisted finding fails and a stale entry fails, so remove an entry as soon as the advisory is fixed. Do not add an entry without the advisory URL and a reason.

advisories.reason: ReDoS in single-branch repeated extglobs. picomatch is a dev-only transitive dependency of vite/typescript-eslint (console build and lint); it is not shipped in the runtime image. The advisory's patched_versions is '<0.0.0' and the latest published version (4.0.7) is still in the vulnerable range, so there is no upgrade that clears it. Remove this entry when a patched picomatch is published.
